value.rationale: The Shrikhande and 4x4 rook graphs are the sole classical strongly regular (16,6,2,2) twins, so contrasting complete induced-matching polynomials is a natural graph invariant rather than an arbitrary slice. Their very different maximum induced matching sizes and opposite exchange mobility (all 32 frozen versus connected 216-state 16-regular diameter-three graph) give a usable exact structural benchmark for edge-packing and optimum-solution reconfiguration. The comparison explicitly does not claim to be the first graph distinguishing invariant.
